meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将超出单机内存的数据分析任务扩展到分布式集群并行处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果数据处理量大到单机内存装不下
copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas/NumPy workflows beyond memory on distributed clusters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to process datasets too large for a single machine's memory.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 Dask 处理超出内存的 pandas/NumPy 数据:并行读取多个 CSV/Parquet、按分块计算、也可跨机器分布式执行,运算延迟到调用 compute() 才真正算出。
howto.when: 当数据超出可用内存,或需要把现有 pandas/NumPy 代码扩展到多核、多机集群时接管。单机 out-of-core 用 vaex、追求内存内速度用 polars 的场景不适用。

say.text: 用 Client() 起一个本地集群,并行提交这些任务再汇总结果
用 bag 读取 logs/*.json,清洗后转成 DataFrame
say.note: 适合非结构化文本/JSON 的清洗

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude uses Dask to run pandas/NumPy work that is larger than RAM: reading many CSV/Parquet files in parallel, computing in chunks, or across a cluster. Operations stay lazy until compute() is called.
howto.when_en: Triggers when data exceeds available memory, or you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code across cores or machines. For single-machine out-of-core use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

say_en.text: Read data/2024-*.csv with dask, filter value>100 and group by category
say_en.note: Builds a lazy graph; compute() returns the result
